urls.title: Websites or domains
urls.description: One website per line, e.g. acme.com or https://shop.acme.com/.

includeDetails.title: Include technology details
includeDetails.description: Add the full technologies array (version, confidence, categories, website, SaaS/open-source flags, pricing tier) to each row. Turn off for a compact CSV.

includeFailed.title: Include failed / empty websites
includeFailed.description: Also output websites that failed to load or where nothing was detected. These are never charged.

concurrency.title: Parallel websites
concurrency.description: How many websites to analyze at the same time.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a website after this many seconds.
